finalists.label: Systemic Amyloidosis
finalists.why: Evidence from laboratory tests, including anemia, abnormal liver function, and renal impairment, along with positive Congo red staining

frontier_selector.why: The champion is chosen because it is the most specific diagnosis that accounts for the majority of the findings, including the positive Congo red staining and the presence of amyloid deposits in the skin biopsy

support_spans: Hematoxylin-eosin staining showed upper dermal amorphous eosinophilic deposits
Congo red staining results were positive
Polarizing light microscopy demonstrated pale apple-green birefringence

The purpura and ecchymoses, initially periorbital, progressed over the previous 12 months
